stage: 1: gas-phase isolated monomer validation; written before execution
primary_method: GFN2-xTB, gas phase, unscaled harmonic normal modes at optimized geometry
secondary_method: GFN1-xTB, diagnostic model sensitivity only, not substituted for a failed primary method
reference: NIST WebBook gas-phase IR frequencies, Shimanouchi (1972)
interpretation: A harmonic frequency isotope shift is possible with classical nuclei on the same potential. This experiment alone cannot establish the necessity of nuclear quantum dynamics. Harmonic versus fundamental mismatch includes anharmonicity and electronic-model error.
expansion_rule: Review all primary validation criteria before extending the molecular model. If failed, report the failure and keep liquid nuclear-quantum and micro-to-macro causal claims unestablished.
